title: The prompt context retrieves over all history when the session directory names no project
notes: Owner request, 2026-11-24: atrium should work anywhere. A session opened in the home directory or outside any repository got no context and no footer line, which read as the mod not being installed (office Mac).
done_when: The atrium-context mod and the shell prompt hook ask atrium context without --project when the directory names no project, with tests
result: The prompt context retrieves over all history when the session directory names no project
evidence: plugins/atrium-context 0.14.0: retrieve() asks again without --project on exit 2 (tests 'retrieves over all history outside a project', 'stays silent when even an unscoped retrieval is refused'); plugins/atrium-codex/hooks/user_prompt_context.py omits --project outside a project (tests/test_prompt_context_hook.py). claude plugin test: 40 pass, 1 fail that also fails on main; pytest 879 passed
